title: Use multimodal reference assets in Seedance to keep character identity…
content:
Use multimodal reference assets in Seedance to keep character identity consistent across the story.  
Use multimodal reference assets in Seedance to maintain a consistent environment across the story.  
Use multimodal reference assets in Seedance to enforce motionlessness (static elements) across the story.  
Use multimodal reference assets in Seedance to control and keep consistent camera language across the story.  
Use multimodal reference assets in Seedance to guide voice and rhythm across the story.  
In Seedance 2.5, load up to 50 reference assets to guide what matters across the story.
